method: Environment edge measured on gridded plate crops as a fraction of plate width at the content band, mapped through object-fit: cover + object-position (50% mobile, 56% tablet, 62% desktop). CSS: src/projects/jurnl/runtime/jurnl-setup.css (--f02-edge-f per data-jrn-plate). Pixel values below are measured live in the runtime by scripts/jurnl/f02-final-audit-qa.mjs.
formula: edge_x = px*100cqw + (f - px)*max(100cqw, 56.25cqh); rail = clamp(160px, edge_x - gap - left, max); gap 14 mobile / 32 tablet+desktop; max 400 tablet / 420 desktop

curtain_boundary.edge: Sheer curtain, left edge at the panel band (it leans right as it falls).

screens.panel_width_rule: Rows, consents, fields, errors fill the rail (trailing controls share one column). Read-only path / recap lists take max-content (min 200, max rail).

cta_width_policy.mobile: BOTTOM_ANCHORED_NEAR_FULL_WIDTH (founder exception: rests on the stone ledge / cushion band, covers no focal object; F01 contract + thumb reach)

screens.mobile_behavior: Rail from the 34 px grid line to the plate edge minus 14 px. Headline, helper, panels, rows, fields, errors, foot inside. Primary CTA bottom-anchored near full width; SKIP FOR NOW a left-grid paper chip.
screens.tablet_behavior: Left rail from 72 px (never centred), width = plate edge − 32 px gap, max 400. CTA follows content at rail width.
screens.desktop_behavior: 420 px column at 72 px, left of every environment edge (≥ 720 px). CTA follows content at column width.
